facts.text: A camera collects visible light through a lens onto a grid of light-sensitive cells and produces a color image that a computer can search for people and objects.
facts.quote: A camera collects visible light through a lens onto a grid of light-sensitive cells and produces a color image that a computer can search for people and objects.

facts.text: A camera image that looks right can still be physically wrong at the detector.
facts.quote: a picture that looks right can still be physically wrong at the detector.

facts.text: Camera glare depends on the lens, cover window, ghost paths, coatings, saturation and image signal processor (ISP).
facts.quote: Glare depends on the lens, cover window, ghost paths, coatings, saturation and ISP

facts.text: Camera behavior in darkness depends on gain, noise and high dynamic range (HDR).
facts.quote: darkness depends on gain, noise and HDR

facts.text: LED work lights can flicker in ways a normal renderer does not represent.
facts.quote: LED work lights can flicker in ways a normal renderer does not represent [Chapter 6].

facts.text: A good camera model needs supplier information on lens distortion, spectral response, shutter timing, noise versus gain, HDR behavior, ISP functions and compression.
facts.quote: A good camera model needs the lens distortion, spectral response, shutter timing, noise versus gain, HDR behavior, ISP functions and compression from the supplier [Chapter 6].

facts.text: Camera recordings should retain frames at native or lossless quality and log exposure, gain and HDR state, because lossy video changes detector outputs.
facts.quote: Recordings should keep frames at native or lossless quality with exposure, gain and HDR state logged, because lossy video changes what a detector outputs [Chapter 7].

facts.text: Cameras are the only sensor that easily distinguishes a person from a post.
facts.quote: Cameras are the only sensor that easily tells a person from a post

facts.text: Cameras are weak in dust, darkness and glare.
facts.quote: they are weak in dust, darkness and glare

facts.text: A fog chamber study showed simulated image trends following real image trends.
facts.quote: a fog chamber study showed simulated image trends following real ones

facts.text: No independent comparison of simulated and real camera imagery was found for glare or site lighting.
facts.quote: no independent comparison was found for glare or site lighting [Chapter 6].

facts.text: A site at dawn with floodlights is a hard case for camera high dynamic range (HDR).
facts.quote: High dynamic range (HDR) is the ability to see the sunlit sky and the shadow under a truck in one frame; a site at dawn with floodlights is a hard case.

facts.text: Rolling shutter can produce a skewed camera image when an object moves fast or the camera vibrates, because sensor rows are read sequentially.
facts.quote: Rolling shutter means the sensor reads its rows one after another, so a fast object or a vibrating camera gives a skewed image

facts.text: Camera exposure and gain trade brightness against noise in darkness.
facts.quote: Exposure and gain trade brightness against noise in the dark.
